stemMd: How many integers from 1 through 60 inclusive are divisible by 4 or by 6?
explanationMd: There are 15 multiples of 4 and 10 of 6. Five multiples of 12 are counted twice, so inclusion–exclusion gives 15+10−5=20.

distractorRationale.e: This double-counts numbers divisible by both.
distractorRationale.a: This counts only multiples of their least common multiple.
